parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is not specified. Valid values:

*   True
*   False

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

Valid values:

*   Node
*   Cluster

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller untag-resources --resource-type Cluster --resource-id i15z93xkon193oaxf1ese8 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag-key ac-cus-tag-0 --all false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eflo-controller UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 i15z93xkon193oaxf1ese8 --TagKey.1 'ac-cus-tag-0' --ResourceType Cluster --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
